qualitative.note: Fails Gate 1 (REJECT). Barclays is a universal banking group with a massive global Investment Bank division (£11B+ income, ~40% of group total) carrying complex trading books, extensive derivative liabilities, and opaque market-making balance sheet exposures that cannot be verified or modeled from the outside by an independent investor.
qualitative.evidence: Barclays operates across UK retail banking, UK corporate banking, US consumer cards, and a global Investment Bank (Global Markets and Investment Banking fees). The Investment Bank division ties up the majority of group risk-weighted assets and generates volatile earnings with substantial Level 2/3 fair value instruments. Over the last decade, group RoTE has frequently languished below its cost of equity (averaging 7-9%), with recurring restructuring charges and litigation provisions.
